Jasmine Kaur is a reliable, detail-oriented engineer who consistently delivers high-quality code under tight deadlines. As a senior frontend engineer at CapitalFlow, she owns critical components of our platform, including the real-time dashboard for institutional clients. Her React-based solutions cut load times by 40% through optimized data fetching and component architecture. She also spearheaded a TypeScript refactor of our legacy codebase, reducing bug reports by 30% in six months.  

Beyond technical skills, Jasmine excels at collaborating across teams. She mentored two junior engineers through complex state management challenges, ensuring their solutions aligned with our security protocols. Her proactive approach to feedback—whether from QA or product—has minimized rework and improved cross-team alignment.  

Jasmine’s impact extends beyond her code. She designed a compliance-centric UI that streamlined regulatory reporting, saving the team 20+ hours weekly. Her ability to balance technical depth with user needs has made her a go-to for high-stakes projects. She also maintains rigorous test automation suites, ensuring our frontend meets strict performance and accessibility standards.  

Jasmine is a self-starter who thrives in fast-paced environments. Her work ethic, technical precision, and collaborative mindset make her a standout contributor. I’d welcome the opportunity to advocate for her in any role where she can leverage her expertise and drive results.
